name: ToGo mobile (Expo tunnel)
// purpose: GitHub Codespaces config for testing the Expo passenger app on a phone via `expo start --tunnel`. Codespaces has open outbound internet, so the Expo/ngrok tunnel (blocked in the build environment) can establish a public URL an iPhone reaches. This file provisions NOTHING paid by itself; running a Codespace may consume your GitHub Codespaces quota (see docs/MOBILE.md).
